about: Renders a hairline separator across a column or down a row, or a label between two lines. A line is an `hr` with the separator role. A labelled line is a `div`, so a screen reader reads its label as text.

feed.about: The days of an activity feed in a 320px room, each labelled at the start of its line with `labelPlacement="start"`.
feed.title: Labelled days

horizontal.about: An order summary in a 320px room. A horizontal divider separates its lines from the total.
horizontal.title: Horizontal

labelPlacement.about: `labelPlacement` puts the label at the start, the centre or the end of its line. `start` and `end` follow the writing direction and drop the line on their side.
labelPlacement.title: Label placement

signIn.about: A sign-in form in a 320px room, where a centred label names the choice between a passkey and an email address.
signIn.title: Sign in

title: Divider

vertical.about: Two groups of toolbar buttons separated by a vertical divider, which stretches to the height of the row and sets `aria-orientation="vertical"`.
vertical.title: Vertical
